notes: Volume S–U of the collection: 69 pages, 51 entries (44 under S, 6 under T, 1 under U) covering architects, builders, landscape architects, a contractor-preservationist, two merchant-builder firms and three architecture firms, read end to end — the title page, the three letter indexes, every entry (education, firms, cultural identification, narrative and footnotes), every 'Projects in San Francisco', 'Renovation Projects in San Francisco' and 'Other notable projects' list, and every figure caption. The seventh of the eight letter-range PDFs. No inventory table and no APN anywhere. Twelve entries yielded no numbered San Francisco address: Helen Aycrigg Schellman, Katherine Lockwood Squire, Sara Waldner Bould Stan, Henrietta May Steinmesch, A. C. Schweinfurt and John Hudson Thomas have no San Francisco work in the volume at all; Claude Stoller and Worley Wong's entries are bare cross-references to a partner; William Turnbull Jr. heads a 'Projects in San Francisco' list with nothing under it; Nagao Sakurai's landscapes, Leonard Schultze's Parkmerced and Newton J. Tharp's four San Francisco General Hospital buildings are given by park, development or campus rather than by number. Hideo Sasaki's five San Francisco landscapes are all given as plazas and redevelopment projects; only One Maritime Plaza was recorded, and it does not resolve.

coverage.remaining: Nothing. Volume V–Z was read in the same run and the eight-volume collection is complete.
